name: DSEC
summary: 真实驾驶的双目事件与彩色图像序列，提供同步传感器数据、视差及后续发布的光流真值。
summaryEn: Real driving sequences with stereo events and color images, aligned sensors, disparity, and subsequently released optical-flow truth.
scale: 53 driving sequences with VGA event cameras
scaleZh: 53 段驾驶序列，使用 VGA 事件相机
organizations: University of Zurich Robotics and Perception Group
organizationsZh: 苏黎世大学机器人与感知研究组
access: Official sensor downloads and flow/disparity benchmarks
accessZh: 官方传感器数据下载及光流、视差基准
wmNote: 收录依据是连续驾驶观测及跨时刻光流；静态检测或语义子集不单独作为动力学证据。
wmNoteEn: Continuous observations and temporal flow provide dynamics evidence; static detection or semantic subsets alone do not.
